void-base.$description: Void Base — Primary page background and hero section — the near-black violet creates depth without being neutral charcoal

elevated-surface.$description: Elevated Surface — Card backgrounds (rgb(26,22,36)) — one step above void, visible as panels

deep-panel.$description: Deep Panel — Secondary card surface (rgb(27,23,40)) — close to Elevated Surface, used for 24px-radius feature cards

muted-shell.$description: Muted Shell — Ghost button backgrounds — semi-transparent frosted layer over dark surfaces

border-smoke.$description: Border Smoke — Nav and container borders — low-contrast edge definition on dark surfaces

ash-text.$description: Ash Text — Primary body and UI text — warm-gray rather than pure white, reducing harshness against dark bg

fog-text.$description: Fog Text — Secondary body text, captions, de-emphasized labels

silver-rail.$description: Silver Rail — Border lines across components and nav — light border on dark background creates fine hairline edges

cloud-white.$description: Cloud White — High-emphasis headings, icon fills, badge text, active nav items

steel-muted.$description: Steel Muted — Badge text on light badge backgrounds

ember-cta.$description: Ember CTA — Primary CTA buttons — orange-to-red gradient (rgb(253,137,37) → rgb(255,12,0)) burns against the dark void; the only warm-chromatic element above the fold, creating immediate focal pull

electric-current.$description: Electric Current — Link underline glow, active focus rings, node connection lines in workflow canvas — blue-to-violet gradient (rgb(7,122,199) → rgb(107,33,239)) signals data flow and connectivity

ember-scorch.$description: Ember Scorch — Icon fills and secondary highlight accents — pure saturated red-orange for SVG emphasis marks

crimson-glow.$description: Crimson Glow — Card box-shadow tint — dark muted red used in shadow layers beneath cards, creating a heat-haze underneath panels

geomanist.$description: The sole display and body typeface. Weight 300 at 48–54px is the defining choice — headlines whisper against the dark background rather than asserting. Weight 400 handles body copy at 15–18px with 1.5–1.7 line-height for comfortable reading in dark contexts. The compressed line-height of 0.88 at 54px stacks headline lines into a dense visual block.

geomanist-book.$description: Medium-emphasis subheadings and section labels. The 'book' variant sits optically between 300 and regular 400, used for callout text in feature cards and section introductions at 20–24px.
